metaDescription: Order custom cotton poly workwear for your team. Durable, breathable, and perfect for branding. Get a quote today at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Cotton poly workwear combines the softness and breathability of cotton with the durability and wrinkle resistance of polyester. This blend is ideal for uniforms that need to withstand daily wear while keeping employees comfortable. Whether you outfit a restaurant staff with branded aprons or supply a warehouse crew with sturdy shirts, cotton poly offers easy care and long-lasting color. Screen printing or embroidery adheres well to this fabric, making your logo stand out. Choose custom cotton poly workwear for a professional look that works as hard as your team.
heroAltText: Custom cotton poly workwear featuring a branded medium length apron with pouch, durable and comfortable for restaurant staff.
